def build_agent(sandbox):
    # Chassis placed at y=1.7 to ensure wheels are in ground contact (y=1.5)
    chassis = sandbox.add_beam(x=6.9, y=1.7, width=1.0, height=0.2, density=1.5)
    sandbox.set_fixed_rotation(chassis, True)
    
    # Wheels placed at y=1.5 (ground level + radius 0.7)
    wheel_radius = 0.7
    wheel_y = 1.0 + wheel_radius  # Ensures bottom of wheel is at ground level y=1.0
    wheel1 = sandbox.add_wheel(x=6.9 - 0.4, y=wheel_y, radius=wheel_radius, density=1.5)
    wheel2 = sandbox.add_wheel(x=6.9 + 0.4, y=wheel_y, radius=wheel_radius, density=1.5)
    
    # High friction for better traction on high-friction ground
    sandbox.set_material_properties(wheel1, friction=5.0)
    sandbox.set_material_properties(wheel2, friction=5.0)
    
    # Connect wheels to chassis with pivot joints
    joint1 = sandbox.add_joint(chassis, wheel1, (6.9 - 0.4, wheel_y), type='pivot')
    joint2 = sandbox.add_joint(chassis, wheel2, (6.9 + 0.4, wheel_y), type='pivot')
    
    # Store joints and wheels for control
    global joints, wheels
    joints = [joint1, joint2]
    wheels = [wheel1, wheel2]
    return chassis
